title: TCP and TLS

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the data format to be printed.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Target host where Fluent Bit or Fluentd are listening for Forward messages.

fields.name: json_date_format
fields.description: Specify the format of the date.

fields.name: json_date_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the time key in the output record.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target service.

fields.name: raw_message_key
fields.description: If set, the value of this key is sent as the raw message payload without additional formatting.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The TCP and TLS output plugin lets you send records to a remote TCP server.
